description: [Macro Desk] The US macro backdrop from FRED: the fed funds rate (DFF), CPI (CPIAUCSL), unemployment (UNRATE), the 10y-2y spread (T10Y2Y) and the 10-year yield (DGS10). One series returns its recent history; with no series the full bundle is returned. Requires a connected fAlpha account; not included in the free trial.

series_id.description: One FRED series: DFF, CPIAUCSL, UNRATE, T10Y2Y or DGS10. Without it, the full bundle is returned.
